newsitem.title: KENYA: Missing Rwandans reported found dead in Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Missing Rwandans reported found dead in Kenya.

text.p: An exiled former Rwandan intelligence chief and a businessman were found dead on Wednesday, three days after disappearing in Nairobi, a Rwandan refugee official said.

Innocent Butare, spokesman for the Rally for the Return of Refugees and Democracy in Rwanda (RDR), said Colonel Theoneste Lizinde and exiled businessman Augustine Bujulifura, both Hutus, were found dead in Kiambu district on the outskirts of Nairobi.

Lizinde served as Rwanda's chief of intelligence in the government of late Hutu president Juvenal Habyarimana between 1973-80. He was jailed for plotting against Habyarimana from 1980 until Tutsi rebels fighting Habyarimana freed him in 1992.
He served the new Tutsi-appointed Rwandan government as a member of parliament and a senior military officer before fleeing into exile last year after accusing the Tutsi army of persecuting Hutus.
